finding.expected: Reuse the existing canonical remediation-action contract from src/aios_renew/review.py when validating the bounded finding material; do not maintain a second literal enum or duplicate semantic action authority in decision_packet.py. Preserve the new minimum finding/lineage input shape, exact Unified State set matching, ordering neutrality, substitution/cross-lineage fail-closed behavior, and the no-RESULT/no-EVIDENCE property. Add regression coverage that ties accepted finding actions to the canonical action contract rather than a Decision Packet-local redeclaration.
finding.issue: The minimum finding/lineage redesign correctly removes per-item RESULT/REVIEW material, but _finding_entry re-declares the canonical remediation action enum locally as {"CODE_FIX", "EVIDENCE_ONLY"}. TASK-178 r2 explicitly forbids re-declaring REVIEW/REMEDIATION/REPAIR semantic enums where an existing canonical contract can be reused, and src/aios_renew/review.py already owns REMEDIATION_ACTIONS. This creates a second semantic action contract inside the Decision Packet compiler that can drift from Reviewer/Remediation authority while still passing its local tests.

original_constraints: AIOS_DECISION_PACKET v1 remains one deterministic, read-only, provider-neutral envelope for exactly one selected semantic decision and supports exactly the existing six BP-3 flows: ARCHITECTURE, TASK_AUTHORING, SEMANTIC_REVIEW, REMEDIATION_AUTHORING, REPAIR_AUTHORING and DIAGNOSTIC. NONE, unknown flows, unknown payload kinds and packet nesting fail closed.

Keep canonical facts, bounded observations, Executor claims, prior semantic decisions and current Human input in distinct information classes. RESULT claims remain Executor claims; REVIEW/REMEDIATION/REPAIR remain prior semantic decisions; Human text cannot overwrite canonical subject/provenance/authority. The compiler creates no verdict, hypothesis, correction choice, Executor choice, lifecycle action, publication action or roadmap decision.

Do not modify files outside scope.modify. If satisfying this contract requires changing Unified State, Correction Frontier, Flow Resolver, transport/publication contracts, correction dispatch/approval authority, provider surfaces or frozen Kernel semantics, fail closed back to Brain rather than widening scope.
